extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta's Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1 [cs.CL], 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, and extracted Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content from the Hindawi website was scraped, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to generate the arabic-img2md dataset.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: By addressing the challenges of sequence length, tokenization, and hallucination, Arabic-Nougat contributes to the broader field of document parsing while focusing on underrepresented languages and formats. The open-sourcing of arabic-books, a 1.1 billion-token dataset extracted from Arabic literature, provides a valuable resource for future research in Arabic NLP and OCR.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. The older arabic-small-nougat model occasionally generates irrelevant content, including non-existent URLs or images, due to its early training methodology and smaller training dataset. Both arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat exhibit repetition issues, particularly in lengthy sequences. Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations. The performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. The models are designed for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction tasks. For practical applications, arabic-base-nougat is recommended for general text extraction tasks and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents. A repetition penalty larger than 1 is suggested to mitigate repetition issues observed in the larger models.
